stem:
During a school sports day in Jaipur, Ravi runs 100 m in 20 s and Sameer runs 150 m in 30 s.
Which student is faster?

options.text: Ravi, because he covers less distance
Sameer, because he takes more time
Both are equally fast, because both cover 5 m per second
Sameer, because he covers more distance

teacher.key_rationale: Ravi's speed = 100/20 = 5 m/s; Sameer's speed = 150/30 = 5 m/s. Comparing distance per unit time shows both are equally fast. Options A, B and D reflect comparing only distance or only time without using speed.
